purpose: Pending original-runtime observation checklist, not automated passing tests or equivalence evidence.

steps: Load canonical SWF in isolated reference player
Open How to Play from a fresh menu
Capture entry and representative instruction frames
Allow natural completion with no input
record: Duration from How to Play input to completion
Stops, jumps and nested character motion

steps: Open tutorial from a fresh menu
Activate Skip while a demonstration is in progress
record: Whether tutorial audio or callbacks persist

steps: Observe first customer and first clock tick
record: Day, clock, cash and lost-customer initial values
First spawn time and identity/table choice
Clock origin relative to first spawn

steps: Pick up batter and pour one dosa
Repeat controlled trials around flip and pickup boundaries
Hold cooked food then cancel pickup
Allow an unserved dosa to burn and disappear
record: Real elapsed time and original frame when measurable
Frozen held pose and resumed pose

steps: Serve fewer, exactly and more dosas than requested in independent trials
Attempt serving during eating and exit
record: Input allowed in each customer state

steps: Observe an unserved customer's full patience cycle
Complete an order for each of five customer identities

record: Any sounds not affected by mute

steps: Capture game-over state and score form without submitting
record: Absence or presence of accumulated callbacks
Do not submit any remote score

steps: Arrange day end near customer loss
Arrange food removal near customer loss
record: Whether any callbacks occur after screen transition

steps: Reach or reproducibly configure days 7, 8 and 9 in the isolated reference runtime
record: Any timing or difficulty cap actually observed
